rule: Nothing is a model input, rating bonus or bet trigger because it is premium data. A field family may be used as a PREDICTOR only when a pre-registered chronological test shows it beats the real Champion (plus raw volume where relevant) and a prospective check does not contradict it. Until then Fantasy Points data is descriptive evidence.

statuses.PREDICTIVE_CANDIDATE: evidence suggests possible incremental forecasting value over the Champion; not yet confirmed prospectively
statuses.DESCRIPTIVE_EVIDENCE: explains role / matchup / thesis; no demonstrated incremental prediction (tested without gain, or untested)
statuses.REJECTED_AS_PREDICTOR: tested and failed to improve the relevant baseline
statuses.NEEDS_PROSPECTIVE_DATA: cannot be evaluated honestly yet (no historical point-in-time data)

families.family: Expected fantasy points / expected TDs (XFP, XTD)
families.finding: Adds a little to the Champion for rushing yards/TDs, but adds nothing beyond ffopportunity expected points, which GOING already has free (E8 MEOFP vs MEOP: INCONCLUSIVE/REJECTED on every market). Redundant source.

families.family: Route participation, TPRR, target share, first-read/designed share (compact set)
families.finding: The 16-feature bundle failed (E1, E3). A 3-feature compact set was directionally positive but inconclusive and post-hoc (E6). In-season role needs the 2026 weekly trend states.
Part of the failed bundle; no gain beyond prior production and in-season usage. Valid as a deployment descriptor.

families.family: Separation score / win rate (alignment, break, coverage, route)
families.finding: Untested as a predictor. Testable on completed seasons (wave 3 candidate). Several columns are unit-unstable (Post route share).

families.family: Man/zone and coverage splits x opponent coverage mix
families.finding: The interaction did not improve weekly yardage or target prediction (0 of 2 seasons). 2021 coverage scales differ. Still useful to explain a matchup.

families.family: Bell-cow role shares (snap %, carry share, target share, XFP share)
families.finding: No gain over Champion plus raw volume for carries, rushing yards or rushing TDs.

families.family: Advanced rushing efficiency (success %, stuff %, contact yardage, missed tackles, explosive %)
families.finding: Worse than the baseline in every outcome (0 of 3 seasons better): efficiency does not persist.

families.family: Role stability (team carry-share mean, spread and trend, from nflverse)
families.finding: +0.5% on carries, +0.25% on rushing yards: inconclusive.

families.family: Team run/pass splits by game script
families.finding: No gain predicting next-season pass rate (low power).

families.family: QB pressure, time to throw, depth
families.finding: Untested. GOING already applies a pressure scale to QB yards. Candidate for wave 3 on completed seasons.

families.family: OL/DL matchups, QB/WR coverage matchups, next-game tables
families.finding: Forward-looking and 2026 only; stored with each weekly trend state.

non_fantasy_points_finding: The signals that DID beat or help the Champion in wave 2 are not Fantasy Points fields: (1) a prior-strength blend instead of 80/20 current-season weighting (E7), (2) ffopportunity in-season expected volume and (3) raw target/carry volume (E8). Fantasy Points data is the least additive source tested so far.
